category_title: Students at risk of educational failure with significant instructional and behavioral disengagement
scenario_title: One-on-one transcription focusing on letter formation and visual details
minimal_context: The student is working one-on-one with the teacher to transcribe letters to upper-case on a worksheet using an alphabet table.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's transcribe these letters to upper-case on your worksheet. Start with the letter 'i'.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Writes the upper-case 'I' and adds the top and bottom serifs, as shown in the alphabet table.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. Now let's do the upper-case 'N'. Write it here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes an incorrect first attempt at the upper-case 'N', then grimaces and looks at the teacher as she erases the letter.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Points to the lower-case 't' and locates it in the alphabet table) This is a 't'. Which letter are you going to write?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Points to the upper-case 'T') I don't know how to write it.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's transcribe these letters to upper-case on your worksheet. Start with the letter 'i'.

STUDENT: (Writes the upper-case 'I' and adds the top and bottom serifs, as shown in the alphabet table.)

TUTOR: Okay. Now let's do the upper-case 'N'. Write it here.

STUDENT: (Makes an incorrect first attempt at the upper-case 'N', then grimaces and looks at the teacher as she erases the letter.)

TUTOR: (Points to the lower-case 't' and locates it in the alphabet table) This is a 't'. Which letter are you going to write?

STUDENT: (Points to the upper-case 'T') I don't know how to write it.

context.time_context: At the end of the time allocated to the lesson

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Pointed to the lower-case 't', said the name of the letter, located it in the alphabet table and then asked him which letter he was going to write
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Pointed to the upper-case 'T', but said: 'I don't know how to write it'
related_quotes: I don't know how to write it

behavior_patterns.condition: When transcribing a lower-case 'i' to an upper-case 'I'
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Added the top and bottom serifs, as shown in the alphabet table

behavior_patterns.condition: When his first attempt at the upper-case 'N' was incorrect and the teacher erased the letter
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Grimaced and looked at his teacher
